notes.text: Band 10 (MainZone-Continued, the 'continued' flag) holds only line 39 at y 6481-6541, a speck-sized mark at the page foot, not a printed line; the editor may want to delete the band. Bands 2-9 are the Primechaniya notes 3-10, each opening on an indented 'N (str. M).' opener, so each is rightly MainZone-P.
